About the Project

IMPRS Brain and Behavior recruits researchers for doctoral work in neuroscience. The 2027 intake uses the programme's selection process, with an online symposium for shortlisted candidates. Applicants should confirm the funding package with the graduate school because the checked call did not give an amount.

Research Areas

  • Neuroscience
  • Brain function
  • Behaviour

About Max Planck Society

The Max Planck Society operates research institutes and International Max Planck Research Schools in Germany. Doctoral candidates work within a selected institute or partner university, with funding and supervision arranged through the programme or project.

Official details: Read the programme or project information

Application route: Follow the official application instructions

Application guides

  • How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps
  • Academic CV for PhD Applications: Structure and an Example
  • Studying in Germany: Tuition Fees, Living Costs and Funding

Official Link

https://www.imprs-brain-behavior.mpg.de/selection_process

Important Notes

  • Always confirm the full requirements and current deadline on the official website before applying.
  • Prepare the requested documents early — competitive awards are often decided on complete, on-time submissions.
  • Funding terms shown here reflect the listing at the time of publication and can be updated by the provider.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 15 October 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.
